description.zh:
实例规格所属的架构类型。取值范围：

- X86：X86计算。
- Heterogeneous：异构计算，例如GPU或FPGA等。
- BareMental：弹性裸金属服务器。
- Arm：Arm计算。

默认值：包含所有架构类型。
description.en:
The architecture types of the instance type. Valid values:

- X86: x86 computing.
- Heterogeneous: heterogeneous computing, such as GPU or FPGA.
- BareMental: ECS Bare Metal Instance.
- Arm: Arm computing.

Default value: all architecture types.

description.zh:
是否为性能突发实例规格。取值范围：

- Exclude：不包含性能突发实例规格。
- Include：包含性能突发实例规格。
- Required：只包含性能突发实例规格。

默认值：Include。
description.en:
Specifies whether to include burstable performance instance types. Valid values:

- Exclude: excludes burstable performance instance types.
- Include: includes burstable performance instance types.
- Required: includes only burstable performance instance types.

Default value: Include.

description.zh:
渠道ID。
>该参数不对外开放（仅为内部保留参数）。
description.en:
The channel ID.
>This parameter is not publicly available (internal reserved parameter only).

description.zh: 实例规格的vCPU内核数目。
description.en: The number of vCPU cores of the instance type.

description.zh: 实例规格的vCPU内核数目，可以指定多个。
description.en: The number of vCPU cores of the instance type. You can specify multiple values.

description.zh: 实例规格的CPU架构。
description.en: The CPU architectures of the instance type.

description.zh:
需要排除的实例规格。通过使用通配符（*）可以排除单个规格或者整个规格族。例如：

- ecs.c6.large：表示排除ecs.c6.large实例规格。
- ecs.c6.*：表示排除整个c6规格族的实例规格。

>如果需要排除多个实例规格，请使用分隔符（/）隔开单个实例规格。例如`ecs.n1.small/ecs.n1.*/*7*`。
description.en:
The instance types to exclude. You can use wildcard characters (*) to exclude a single instance type or an entire instance family. Examples:

- ecs.c6.large: excludes the ecs.c6.large instance type.
- ecs.c6.*: excludes all instance types in the c6 instance family.

>To exclude multiple instance types, separate them with forward slashes (/). Example: `ecs.n1.small/ecs.n1.*/*7*`.

description.zh: GPU 类型。
description.en: The GPU types.

description.zh:
实例规格分类。取值范围：

- General-purpose： 通用型。
- Compute-optimized：计算型。
- Memory-optimized：内存型。
- Big data：大数据型。
- Local SSDs ：本地 SSD 型。
- High Clock Speed ：高主频型。
- Enhanced ：增强型。
- Shared：共享型。
- Compute-optimized with GPU ：GPU 计算型。
- Visual Compute-optimized ：视觉计算型。
- Heterogeneous Service ：异构服务型。
- Compute-optimized with FPGA ：FPGA 计算型。
- Compute-optimized with NPU ：NPU 计算型。
- ECS Bare Metal ：弹性裸金属服务器。
- High Performance Compute：高性能计算型。
description.en:
The instance type categories. Valid values:

- General-purpose: general-purpose type.
- Compute-optimized: compute-optimized type.
- Memory-optimized: memory-optimized type.
- Big data: big data type.
- Local SSDs: local SSD type.
- High Clock Speed: high clock speed type.
- Enhanced: enhanced type.
- Shared: shared type.
- Compute-optimized with GPU: GPU compute-optimized type.
- Visual Compute-optimized: visual compute-optimized type.
- Heterogeneous Service: heterogeneous service type.
- Compute-optimized with FPGA: FPGA compute-optimized type.
- Compute-optimized with NPU: NPU compute-optimized type.
- ECS Bare Metal: ECS Bare Metal Instance.
- High Performance Compute: high performance computing type.

description.zh:
实例规格族级别。取值范围：

- EntryLevel：入门级，即共享型实例规格。成本更低，但是无法保证实例计算性能的稳定。适用于平时CPU使用率低的业务场景。更多信息，请参见[共享型](~~108489~~)。
- EnterpriseLevel：企业级。性能稳定，资源独享，适用于对稳定性要求高的业务场景。更多信息，请参见[实例规格族](~~25378~~)。
- CreditEntryLevel：积分入门级，即突发性能实例。通过CPU积分来保证计算性能，适用于平时CPU使用率低、偶有突发CPU使用率的情况。更多信息，请参见[突发性能实例](~~59977~~)。
description.en:
The level of the instance family. Valid values:

- EntryLevel: entry-level, shared instance type. Lower cost but no guaranteed stable computing performance. Suitable for scenarios with generally low CPU utilization. For more information, see [Shared instance families](~~108489~~).
- EnterpriseLevel: enterprise-level. Stable performance with dedicated resources. Suitable for scenarios that require high stability. For more information, see [Instance families](~~25378~~).
- CreditEntryLevel: credit-based entry-level, burstable performance instance. Uses CPU credits to ensure computing performance. Suitable for scenarios with normally low CPU utilization and occasional spikes. For more information, see [Burstable performance instances](~~59977~~).

description.zh: 指定查询的实例规格族。N 表示可以设置多个实例规格族，N 的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: The instance type families to query. N indicates that you can specify multiple instance type families. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

description.zh: 按量付费实例或者抢占式实例可接受的每小时最高价格。
description.en: The maximum acceptable hourly price for pay-as-you-go or preemptible instances.

description.zh: 实例规格的最大vCPU内核数目。
description.en: The maximum number of vCPU cores of the instance type.

description.zh: 实例最大 GPU 数目。取值范围：正整数。
description.en: The maximum number of GPUs of the instance. Valid values: positive integers.

description.zh: 实例最大内存。单位：GiB。
description.en: The maximum memory size of the instance. Unit: GiB.

description.zh: 实例规格的内存大小，单位为GiB。
description.en: The memory size of the instance type. Unit: GiB.

description.zh: 实例规格的内存大小，单位为GiB，可以指定多个。
description.en: The memory size of the instance type. Unit: GiB. You can specify multiple values.

description.zh: 实例最小突发性能实例t5、t6的基准vCPU计算性能（所有vCPU之和）。
description.en: The minimum baseline vCPU computing performance (sum of all vCPUs) for burstable performance instances t5 and t6.

description.zh: 实例规格的最小vCPU内核数目。
description.en: The minimum number of vCPU cores of the instance type.

description.zh: 实例最小单块弹性网卡的IPv6地址上限。
description.en: The minimum number of IPv6 addresses per ENI for the instance.

description.zh: 实例最小单块弹性网卡的IPv4地址上限。
description.en: The minimum number of IPv4 addresses per ENI for the instance.

description.zh: 实例最小支持挂载的弹性网卡上限。
description.en: The minimum number of elastic network interfaces (ENIs) supported by the instance.

description.zh: 实例最小 GPU 数目。取值范围：正整数。
description.en: The minimum number of GPUs of the instance. Valid values: positive integers.

description.zh: 实例最小突发性能实例t5、t6的初始vCPU积分值。
description.en: The minimum initial vCPU credits for burstable performance instances t5 and t6.

description.zh: 实例最小内存。单位：GiB。
description.en: The minimum memory size of the instance. Unit: GiB.

description.zh: 实例的处理器型号。N表示可以设置多个处理器型号，N的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: The processor models of the instance. N indicates that you can specify multiple processor models. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

description.zh: 所属地域ID。
description.en: The ID of the region.

description.zh:
后付费实例的抢占策略。取值范围：

- NoSpot：普通的按量付费实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格。

默认值：NoSpot。
description.en:
The bidding policy for pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:

- NoSpot: a regular pay-as-you-go instance.
- SpotWithPriceLimit: a preemptible instance with a user-defined maximum hourly price.
- SpotAsPriceGo: a preemptible instance for which the system automatically bids with the current market price.

Default value: NoSpot.

description.zh: 交换机的ID列表。
description.en: The list of vSwitch IDs.

description.zh: 可用区ID列表。当传入交换机ID时，此参数无效。
description.en: The list of zone IDs. This parameter is invalid when vSwitch IDs are specified.
